mapper.sql: GUARANTEE_ID, CONTRACT_NO, GUARANTEE_TYPE, GUARANTEE_TYPE_NAME, GUARANTOR, GUARANTOR_ORG_ID, GUARANTOR_ORG_NAME, BORROWER, BORROWER_ORG_ID, BORROWER_ORG_NAME, GUARANTEE_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, START_DATE, END_DATE, GUARANTEE_PERIOD, GUARANTEE_PURPOSE, REMARK, ATTACHMENT_ID, STATUS, APPROVAL_STATUS, APPROVAL_BY, APPROVAL_TIME, APPROVAL_OPINION, RELEASE_DATE, RELEASE_REASON, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_ID, STAFF_ID, DATASOURCE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_FINANCING_GUARANTEE ( GUARANTEE_ID, CONTRACT_NO, GUARANTEE_TYPE, GUARANTEE_TYPE_NAME, GUARANTOR, GUARANTOR_ORG_ID, GUARANTOR_ORG_NAME, BORROWER, BORROWER_ORG_ID, BORROWER_ORG_NAME, GUARANTEE_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, START_DATE, END_DATE, GUARANTEE_PERIOD, GUARANTEE_PURPOSE, REMARK, ATTACHMENT_ID, STATUS, APPROVAL_STATUS, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, ORG_ID, STAFF_ID, DATASOURCE ) VALUES ( #{guaranteeId}, #{contractNo}, #{guaranteeType}, #{guaranteeTypeName}, #{guarantor}, #{guarantorOrgId}, #{guarantorOrgName}, #{borrower}, #{borrowerOrgId}, #{borrowerOrgName}, #{guaranteeAmount}, #{currency}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{guaranteePeriod}, #{guaranteePurpose}, #{remark}, #{attachmentId}, #{status}, #{approvalStatus}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{orgId}, #{staffId}, #{datasource} )
mapper.select: SELECT , CASE STATUS WHEN 0 THEN '草稿' WHEN 1 THEN '生效中' WHEN 2 THEN '已解除' WHEN 3 THEN '已失效' ELSE '未知' END AS STATUS_NAME, CASE APPROVAL_STATUS WHEN 0 THEN '待审批' WHEN 1 THEN '已审批' WHEN 2 THEN '审批拒绝' ELSE '未知' END AS APPROVAL_STATUS_NAME FROM TBL_FINANCING_GUARANTEE WHERE GUARANTEE_ID = #{guaranteeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_FINANCING_GUARANTEE SET STATUS = 2, RELEASE_DATE = SYSDATE, RELEASE_REASON = #{releaseReason}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE GUARANTEE_ID = #{guaranteeId}
